jobs_results.title: Onboarding & Implementation Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

We are looking for a dynamic, energetic, and self-motivated employee to lead our customers through implementations of the Papaya EoR and Payroll solutions. The Onboarding & Implementation Project Manager is a customer-facing role that drives the delivery of implementations, manages, creates, coordinates, and prioritizes projects and tasks, leads timelines, maintains project plans, and communicates status to implementation team members, senior management, and customers.

You will:
• Develop detailed project plans, schedules, project timeline, status reports, and processes to ensure customer... satisfaction, project continuity, and the timely delivery of services.
• Create, optimize, and drive schedules and project plans across cross-functional teams, partners, and customers.
• Anticipate, recognize, and work through resistance or setbacks, work well with others when conflicts arise, ensure alignment with objectives, and ensure project is on schedule.
• Lead customer interactions and act as the main point of contact throughout the implementation, including scheduling and setting the agenda for weekly implementation meetings, preparing status reports, and following up on outstanding deliverables.
• Run the planning and scheduling of multiple simultaneous customer implementation projects. Partner closely with Onboarding and Implementation Managers on delivery of projects that fall within a larger, strategic program of customer work.
• Monitor and measure program/project performance using appropriate tools and techniques.
• Ensure projects are implemented within contractual obligations and established timelines. Escalate to leadership when implementation projects are at risk.
• Maintain positive customer relations utilizing strong communication and customer leadership skills.
• Work cross functionally with other Teams at Papaya to ensure appropriate follow-up of identified customer needs.
• Identify, along with members of the consulting team, additional services which will add value to customers thus enhancing their experience with Papaya
• Participate in internal projects as needed.

Requirements
• 5+ years of experience in a Project Management and/or Sr. Project Management role.
• Experience leading large projects and partnering on delivery of multi-faceted engagements.
• Ability to lead multiple customers and projects/tasks simultaneously.
• Desire to actively lead customers and maintain customer satisfaction through timely follow-up and thorough communication and internal escalations to leadership as needed.
• Strong internal communication skills including the ability to work with all groups and levels of the organization (customer success, sales, marketing, legal, product, operations, finance).
• Must possess initiative to produce improvement initiatives both internally and with customers.

Nice to have
• PMP Certified

jobs_results.title: Project Manager in Avionics
jobs_results.description:
Project Manager in Avionics

DEIMOS is selecting 1 Project Manager to be integrated in the Spanish branch of the Avionics Business Unit to support new growth in the Flight Engineering and Mission Engineering application areas.

The work of the Avionics Business Unit includes activities in the areas of Mission Analysis, Flight Mechanics, GNC/AOCS and Functional Avionics, development of software tools for mission engineering and flight dynamics/mechanics. This covers a diverse range of applications, from interplanetary missions, to Earth Observation satellites and missions, to launch and entry atmospheric vehicles, as well as the associated research, innovation, technology development and programme application and commissioning.

As a matter of reference, DEIMOS has undertaken European-level responsibility in a range of projects, including Launchers and Re-Entry vehicles (e.g.: DEIMOS-Orbex partnership on micro-launchers, IXV and Space Rider programmes, REVLANSYS & REVLANGNC projects... Planetary Entry, Descent and Landing (EDL) (e.g.: EXOMARS programme), Satellite Rendezvous and Servicing (e.g.: Proba3), Earth Observation Mission Design, AOCS and OBSW (e.g.: DEIMOS private satellite programmes), Mission Design and Analysis for Earth Explorer and Copernicus Missions (e.g. FLEX, Sentinel-3) and for activities covering the full product life cycle, from early design to flight and post-flight analyses.

The position includes responsibility at technical and management levels in Avionics BU which is composed of multiple competence centres:
• GNC and AOCS
• Functional Avionics
• Flight Software

Main Duties:

The following responsibilities are envisioned, to be progressively planned and allocated to the candidate:

Coordination with the head of the Avionics Business Unit, and the heads of its competence centres and application areas

Project Management of activities within the Flight Engineering and Mission Engineering Application Areas

Technical Leadership of activities (projects and proposals) within the Flight Engineering and Mission Engineering Application Areas

Support to commercial actions for the Romanian branch of the Flight Systems Business Unit

Education:

Aerospace/aeronautics MSc/MEng degree or PhD, or related (e.g.: Physics, Mathematics).

Professional Experience:

Desired: Project Manager with demonstrated solid technical background in the Aerospace Sector and in management of projects and teams with at least 5 years of experience (relevant PhD studies will also be considered).

The position will be tailored to the level of experience and additional industrial experience would be viewed very positively.

Technical Requirements:

The following capabilities are required for the post:

· Demonstrated background in project management

· Excellent team management skills

· Solid technical background in the aerospace field, in areas such as: flight mechanics (orbital, atmospheric), functional avionics and GNC/AOCS

The following capabilities are desired for the post:

· Knowledge of the Spanish aerospace and/or defence sector

· Knowledge of satellites applications, launch systems, or planetary entry systems (capsules, lifting bodies…)

· Software engineering methods and techniques

· The space programme development cycle

· Experience with Hardware in the loop testing

Language Skills:

High level of English, spoken and written, Italian will be considered a plus.

Personal Skills:
• High motivation
• Capability to integrate in and work with a team from different geographical locations
• Capability to solve complex problems
• Initiative, autonomy, and self-development
• Responsibility towards the customer and workmates
• Advanced presentations and reporting skills

Please, enclose motivation letter to the application

HRRECRUIT-721

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Services
jobs_results.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

Could you be the full-time PROJECT MANAGER Junior for Services business unit in Barcelona we’re looking for?

Your future role

Take on a new challenge and apply your PROJECT MANAGEMENT expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside young and talented teammates.

You'll drive project execution, to maximize the results with respect to cash and margin whilst delivering on time, in conformity with the contract Charter according to Customer expectations and the requirements on EHS. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Customer , Partners... Project Team, Line Managers providing resources, Project Office, Support functions (Finance, Tax, Legal, etc..) and other project stakeholders.

You’ll specifically take care of seeking and proposing to the Customer Director additional opportunities in the frame of the contract Charter, but also ensuring Alstom Transport legal and contractual rights are protected.

We’ll look to you for:
• Plan and manage the complete execution of his/her scope from transfer to close out, in line with Contract Charter requirements.
• Lead a Project Team, including Core Team and when applicable Project Managers of internal and external partners - in line with the project structure.
• Perform project management and contract administration according to Alstom Project Management Manual (PMM), including proactive risk and opportunity management, and in full compliance with E&C rules.
• Ensure completion of Project Performance goals to meet business objectives and customer satisfaction.
• Responsible and accountable for the Project Profit and Loss
• Ensure optimal quality of project execution and reviews.
• Ensure that critical aspects are identified in reviews and proactively / professionally addressed and followed up.
• Manage the situation of the project and its KPIs, and report to senior management, with transparency during the business/sector project reviews or PRB
• Make sure that key project stakeholders are aligned towards project goals.
• Represent Alstom towards Customers and when applicable external stakeholders (Consortium, JV …)
• EHS: Accountable for the proper implementation of the Alstom policy and Customer requirements by all stakeholders
• (internal & external) including suppliers and contractors.
• Responsible to ensure full compliance with Code of Ethics

Performance measurements:
• Sales
• Physical progress
• Gate review Go on time / OTD- GR
• Cash-in
• Customer Satisfaction
• EHS when applicable

All about you

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
• University degree in Engineering.
• Language skills: High level in English is a must. French or other language is an asset
• Desirable career experience in Railways and/or project management.
• Good knowledge of railway products and systems.
• Experience of working in and with multi-national companies and in different business cultures
• Used to work on a goal-driven basis environment
• Conflict management and interpersonal skills
• Team spirit approach and good communication skills,
• Abilities to obtain collaboration and “pull together” all parties involved in the project (especially in case of complex PIO)
• Anticipation, clear reporting,
• Leadership, entrepreneurship mindset and decision minded.
• Strong skills and resilience to manage uncertainty
• Located in Barcelona (availability according to project needs)

Things you’ll enjoy

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career.

You’ll also:
• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
• Contribute to innovative projects
• Utilise our Agile working environment
• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Our Purpose We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results. Title and Summary Project Manager All About Us The Data & Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this agile team is... responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. We combine traditional management consulting with our rich data assets and in-house technology to provide our clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, test-and-learn business experimentation, and data-driven information and risk management services. While specializing in the payments industry, Mastercard Data & Services also works closely with major retailers, airlines, and other enterprises, leveraging data and insights garnered from within and beyond its network. All About the Role Make an Impact as a Project Manager, Advisors Deploy Program Management Advisors Deploy Program Management is an execution-oriented client facing competency that applies proven, accredited change skills and domain experience to partner with clients and help them drive measurable value by: • Delivering new products and strategies to market smoothly and efficiently • Successfully implementing complex technology assets and delivering the most challenging transformation programs to create the new business as usual • Strengthening client’s internal skills, knowledge and experience in critical areas • Transforming client processes and optimizing their management practices Deploy is a new suite of consulting solutions designed to respond to fast evolving customer needs for execution support, with a dual mission: deployment and value realization over the entire lifetime of major assets. Value realization is a complex task, and with Deploy we can de-risk the entire client/asset journey, from implementation to adoption, usage, and product evolution. This is done through a set of new capabilities focused on expert execution support, that we are bringing in to complement the traditional Advisors areas of strength. As our Project Manager, you will manage multiple projects within a portfolio providing efficient and effective coordination of a complex range of activities by clearly defining project team and stakeholder roles and responsibilities that are aligned with the delivery of the expected benefits. You will also ensure effective identification of risks and pro-active solutioning to mitigate risks and impact on timelines. All About You • Experience in delivery of large, complex projects / programs of diverse size in a cross-functional, multicultural environment • Formally trained in a range of project management and change management methodologies and techniques; accredited in one or more recognized PM/PMO/ Change/Service management methodologies is an advantage • Able to plan and manage a multi-workstream program from inception to delivery providing support, direction and / or technical expertise to the project team across multiple disciplines and geographies • Develop strong presence in the client organization extending beyond the immediate boundaries of the program • Bring interesting & relevant industry perspectives, insights and ideas to key stakeholders in the client organization • Strong interpersonal communication and presentation skills. Able to define scope, timelines and budgets in a clear, concise language in writing and verbally. Able to report on issues, risks, progress, timelines etc. accurately and summarize effectively offering analysis, options and credible solutions • Able to handle multiple priorities, work independently, think laterally and manage multiple issues under the pressure of conflicting constraints and limited resources. Perform and articulate cost / benefit / risk analysis • Able to lead, motivate and develop a team of professionals All About Your Education & Skills • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification. Advanced degree or MBA preferred • Professional accreditation such as Project Management Professional (PMP) desirable • Fluent local office language and English required, other languages desirable • Exposure specifically in payments and / or retail banking or merchants preferred • Experience in general consulting desirable • Comfortable with significant client interaction and interest in building relationships • Advanced Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills required, knowledge of Project Management tools preferred • Willingness to travel Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. Everyone wants easier ways to pay; we invent them. Checkout lines are slow; we speed them along. Merchants want more sales; we give them data and insights. People need financial access; we connect them. Corporate purchasing is complicated; we make it simple. Commuters are busy; we speed them on their way. Governments need greater efficiencies; we help create them. Small businesses are virtual; we give them access to a world of buyers. Retailers want to fight fraud; we provide the tools.

Sobre la empresa:
MasterCard

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Supply Chain
jobs_results.description:
Would you like to contribute to a company that has ‘’Feeding the Future’’ as its mission? Do you have experience as a Project Manager? Are you looking for a new challenge in an international animal nutrition company? Then Nutreco has this interesting position for you!

What are you going to do?

Nutreco's mission is to feed the future. We develop and provide innovative feed technologies, premixes and unique software solutions and services for the animal nutrition industry.

In order to continue to fulfill our ambition as a market leader, the intrinsic demands for the growing business and customer support, the company is further investing in the area of Operations. The roles will give you a unique opportunity to work on Quality, HSE and Efficiency Improvement projects. As well as to co-create and further develop our models and solutions with access to a multi-disciplinary and highly motivated team.

What are your key accountabilities?

Project management
• Starting from the high-level... key deliverables (Masterplan) already defined and approved, you will lead the Planning phase in order to create an accurate Project Management Plan (PMP with baselines on scope, costs, steps, milestones and time etc.)
• Lead the Network Optimization project according to Nutreco project management methodology (based on PMI principles)
• Constantly review the project requirements and scope in accordance with stakeholder expectations and form project teams (internal and/or external).
• Identify risks, assess impact and severity. Have in place a risk mitigation plan.
• Coordinate decision-making meetings and make proposals to the Steering Committee.
• Materialize Quick Wins already identified, coordinating the teams to achieve them, and coordinate product allocation, production phase-in and phase-out.
• Ensure the successful completion of the project in terms of scope, schedule, costs and stakeholder management.

Monitoring and auditing
• Generate reports regarding project status, including incidents and risks.
• Track and report on the project budget, scope, and schedule.
• Track operational efficiencies defined in the project and review with controlling team its contribution to cost reduction.

Leadership and people management:

jobs_results.title: Project Manager f/m/d
jobs_results.description:
About Global Rail Group

Global Rail Group is a young but global and fast-growing company working in different domains of international Railway Infrastructure Management. Our focus is on bringing through best practices new technology and digitalisation to the railway industry in order to support the optimisation of the railway asset management.

Our vision

We want to passionately contribute to the success of the railway system both for main line and urban rail transit. Our mission is to ensure the solid and professional set-up and growth of the railways as the most sustainable and environmentally friendly transport system. We are excited to be part of this system

Your role as Project Manager
• You coordinate international projects related to the optimization and digitalization of the railway asset management
• You are the main interface with the customer and ensure that the solution developed meets their needs
• You guarantee proper completion of the project and communication among... the team
• You participate actively in implementing new technology in the field of track maintenance
• You solve unforeseen events that may arise during the course of the project in an efficient and creative manner
• You are part of an international project team
• You take on personal responsibility and contribute to the development and positioning of an innovative consulting company

Your Profile
• University degree in the engineering disciplines
• Minimum of 3 year’s work experience in technical consulting or project management
• Railway-specific knowledge is an advantage
• You are fluent in spoken and written English and, if possible, German
• International travel
• You have analytical thinking skills
• You strive to be solutions oriented

Our Offer
• With us you will be part of a global, rapidly growing team within a global system house in the railway sector, which stands for new and innovative ways in the area of optimising the railway track
• We offer an attractive compensation package (full time employment) that matches your qualifications and professional experience
• With us you can help shape your career, meet short decision-making paths, a tolerant and open community that values your performance and takes your personal needs into account

What to expect from Global Rail Consulting
• We believe that we can only evolve and thrive as a company with a diverse mix of employees and by ensuring a healthy work-life balance
• We have a strong culture of collaboration where Team Spirit, Accountability, Passion, Pioneering Spirit and Performance are key
• We will encourage you to take on new responsibilities, work across different functions, become involved in new projects, as well as completing international assignments
• In return, we have hybrid working option (headquarters, home office) excellent development programs that will help you achieve your career goals and reach your potential

If you are passionate about contributing to the success of the railways system, apply now using the form below.
• Location: Spain, Austria
• Job Type: Full-time, (Hybrid)

Apply Now

Your contact person

Doris Wolfesberger

jobs_results.title: Interim data centre project manager
jobs_results.description:
Perfil buscado (Hombre/Mujer)

The Project Manager´s primary responsibilities are
• overall leadership, direction-setting, delegation, and decision making for the on-site Data Centre team,
• to be the on-site point of contact to lead the data centre build project,
• to ensure success of the project by making key decisions and balancing workload,

This role will include duties for spend reporting, budgeting, strategic planning, staff development, and business partner relationships.
• Execute PMO standards, processes and methodologies in a consistent manner for project planning and execution activities including: scope definition and management; task and resource scheduling; cost and price budgeting; quality review and assurance; client relationship management; project team management; and overall change management.
• Mentor and manage the delivery and execution of data centre project through a balance of best-in-class and pragmatic project methodologies and practices that achieve KPIs... and meet or exceed business results, client satisfaction and SLAs.

• 5+ years´ experience working with General Contractors |7+ years´ experience managing large-scale data centre implementations

Education & Experience:
• Bachelor´s Degree or equivalent, relevant experience
• Area of Study / Degree: BA, Project Management, Engineering, IT or business is desired but not required
• Certifications Preferred: PMP, RCDD, DCDC
• 10 years minimum work experience
• 7+ years´ experience managing large-scale / Hyper-scale data centre implementations
• 5+ years´ experience working with General Contractors and other trades.
• Consulting experience a plus

Skills & Abilities:
• Strong working knowledge of large-scale (i.e. > 500,000 sq. ft.) data centre infrastructure (i.e. structured cabling, networking, rack-and-stack, etc.), gained from prior experience as Project Manager working in the data centre environment.
• Strong leadership, decision-making, and delegation skills are a must. The work environment is a high-paced environment and will require a poised, strong leader to keep the team ontrack, motivated, and moving in the same direction.
• Minimum of 10 years Project Management experience within the technology services industry which includes: overseeing multiple prime contracts; preparing and delivering briefings and recommendations to leadership on a regular basis; managing complex customer requirements across all aspects of cost, schedule, and quality.
• Strong working knowledge of both Waterfall and Agile project management philosophies and the ability to incorporate both into the project as needed.
• Strong understanding of Earned Value Management (EVM) and experience in EVM tools, particularly Primavera P6.
• Strong decision making and delegation skills. Need to be able to make key decisions on the fly and delegate work appropriately when faced with time constraint challenges and changes to the project schedule.
• Superior collaboration and communication skills: team building, conflict resolution, stakeholder management, risk management, product management, negotiation & decision making, ability to work and motivate in a team environment and overall change management.
• Self-motivated with a strong ability to plan/organise workloads.
• Excellent professional service philosophy and understanding the challenges in providing superior customer experience at a national level while controlling costs.

Our Client is a trusted IT solutions provider delivering cutting-edge technology solutions and world-class consulting services to businesses around the globe.

We offer to participate in the first phase of implementation of a singular project until 29 October 2023.
Possibly also participation in the second phase will be offered

jobs_results.description:
Job Posting Title: New Projects Manager

Job ID: [[id]]

Job Code: 30004515

Business Unit: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL TRANSPORTATION (50177402)

Building: Spain Virtual Location (903-ES)

Band/Level: 5-1-C

Hiring Manager: CARLOS GARCIA

Recruiter: INES MALTEZ

Relocation: No

Travel: 25% to 50%

Employee Referral Amount:

Education Experience: Bachelors Degree (High School +4 years)

Employment Experience: 3-5 years

At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

Job Overview

TE Connectivity’s Project Management Teams manage cross functional engineering projects. They work with Product Management, Sales, Quality, Manufacturing, Finance, Production, and other functions across TE to assure projects meet financial, schedule, and customer expectations. They are responsible for defining and creating project schedules, portfolio management, communication and execution of programs... identifying resource constraints and working with management for resolution, while adhering to Lean PD processes.

What your background should look like:

Responsibilities
• Establish and maintain project scope throughout the project lifecycle, including initial setting of scope and scope change management
• Establish and maintain an accurate project schedule using Microsoft project or similar based on commitment from Core team members, customer, and all project stakeholders
• Manage project scope, schedule, and budget for projects within the assigned business segment
• Lead assigned Core Teams to achieve defined objectives
• Develop & manage projects plans and (as needed) gap closure plans
• Follow established Stage Gate processes and assure integrity of project deliverables
• Plan & lead Stage Gate reviews to business segment management
• Utilize enterprise level project systems to manage project plans, data, and actions
• Manage project capital budgets and assure execution in alignment with business unit financial plan
• Assure projects are completed in accordance with business unit objectives for On-Time Delivery and Quality
• Proactively identify & resolve risks & issues and establish escalation path on all projects
• Generate reports (standard and customized) related to project execution
• Conduct status meetings with internal Core Team and external customers
• Track project lessons learned and manage best practices
• Communicate frequently, clearly, concisely with the project team and all stakeholders including senior management

Key Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in related field
• A minimum of 7 years’ experience in managing projects with new product development and/or sustaining project objectives
• General knowledge of Operations/Manufacturing processes
• Experience with LEAN development processes and gate milestone development
• PMI Certification would be desirable
• Industry experience of the connector market would be desirable
• Travel domestic and international possible up to 25%

Experiences & Knowledge
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• Excellent collaboration skills
• Culturally aware and sensitive
• Experience running global projects with virtual teams
• Strong ability to set goals and lead and motivate team members
• Ability to work within a cross functional team to customize variable reports
• Ability to run multiple projects at the same time, global focus
• Proactive, Resilient and Self-confident

Competencies

Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. Our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, renewable energy, automated factories, data centers, medical technology and more. With more than 85,000 employees, including 8,000 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 140 countries. TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

WHAT TE CONNECTIVITY OFFERS:

We are pleased to offer you an exciting total package that can also be flexibly adapted to changing life situations - the well-being of our employees is our top priority!

• Competitive Salary Package

• Performance-Based Bonus Plans

• Health and Wellness Incentives

• Community Outreach Programs / Charity Events

• Employee Resource Group

Across our global sites and business units, we put together packages of benefits that are either supported by TE itself or provided by external service providers. In principle, the benefits offered can vary from site to site

jobs_results.title: Building Engineering Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Building Services... Engineering is a team of over 100 bright experts working in an international environment based out of offices in Madrid and Barcelona, and have completed projects across the globe.

We are looking to hire an inspirational Project Manager (Electrical or Mechanical background) to work closely with clients & architects and deliver upstanding construction projects.

For a successful performance in the role, you will need a strong technical knowledge in MEP engineering and previous experience of delivering large projects from concept design all the way through to tender stage.

We will offer you the opportunity to boost your career working with key stakeholders both nationally and internationally across the AECOM business.

This role is based in Madrid and you will have the flexibility you need for a work-life balance.

Job Responsibilities:
• To lead a team of MEP engineers, technical specialists to support the technical delivery of large building projects
• To actively participate in the development of the delivery team and ensure AECOM delivers the quality required to ensure a successful outcome for AECOM and our Clients.
• Be competent to deliver, review and approve engineering solutions
• Support on bidding opportunities and act as the technical team leader for projects, from feasibility through to handover.
• To identify change and where required liaise/support the project Commercial Manager with supporting technical justification for the change.
• To act as the main point of contact for MEP with design teams.
• Ensure financial targets and internal KPI’s are met including motivating others to contribute.
• To prepare and present designs, reports and specifications.
• Contribute to the update of AECOM standards.
• To grow Client and Architect relationships to support the continued growth of the business.
• To act as a mentor to junior staff, promoting CPD activities.
• To maintain and enhance expertise within the team and as an individual.
• To lead and support AECOM Net zero carbon strategy

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Degree educated in electrical or mechanical engineering or related discipline.
• Experience of seeing conceptual designs through to completion and dealing directly with clients.
• A highly motivated individual with excellent technical understanding of mechanical or electrical engineering along with a solid understanding of the requirements of other disciplines collaborating on multi-disciplinary projects.
• A track record of successful collaboration with design teams nationally and internationally.
• Ability to speak English fluently and communicate effectively in written reports and oral presentations.
• Relevant experience in Building Services design, including areas such as specification writing, calculations, and developing designs from first principles and conversant with national/International codes and standards.
• Able to make decisions, act on their own initiative and operate in a pro-active way.

Job Description

Building Services... Engineering is a team of over 100 bright experts working in an international environment based out of offices in Madrid and Barcelona, and have completed projects across the globe.

We are looking to hire an inspirational Project Manager (Electrical or Mechanical background) to work closely with clients & architects and deliver upstanding construction projects.

For a successful performance in the role, you will need a strong technical knowledge in MEP engineering and previous experience of delivering large projects from concept design all the way through to tender stage.

We will offer you the opportunity to boost your career working with key stakeholders both nationally and internationally across the AECOM business.

This role is based in Madrid and you will have the flexibility you need for a work-life balance.

Job Responsibilities:
• To lead a team of MEP engineers, technical specialists to support the technical delivery of large building projects
• To actively participate in the development of the delivery team and ensure AECOM delivers the quality required to ensure a successful outcome for AECOM and our Clients.
• Be competent to deliver, review and approve engineering solutions
• Support on bidding opportunities and act as the technical team leader for projects, from feasibility through to handover.
• To identify change and where required liaise/support the project Commercial Manager with supporting technical justification for the change.
• To act as the main point of contact for MEP with design teams.
• Ensure financial targets and internal KPI’s are met including motivating others to contribute.
• To prepare and present designs, reports and specifications.
• Contribute to the update of AECOM standards.
• To grow Client and Architect relationships to support the continued growth of the business.
• To act as a mentor to junior staff, promoting CPD activities.
• To maintain and enhance expertise within the team and as an individual.
• To lead and support AECOM Net zero carbon strategy

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Degree educated in electrical or mechanical engineering or related discipline.
• Experience of seeing conceptual designs through to completion and dealing directly with clients.
• A highly motivated individual with excellent technical understanding of mechanical or electrical engineering along with a solid understanding of the requirements of other disciplines collaborating on multi-disciplinary projects.
• A track record of successful collaboration with design teams nationally and internationally.
• Ability to speak English fluently and communicate effectively in written reports and oral presentations.
• Relevant experience in Building Services design, including areas such as specification writing, calculations, and developing designs from first principles and conversant with national/International codes and standards.
• Able to make decisions, act on their own initiative and operate in a pro-active way.
